reason: I already find creators on Instagram and pay them by UPI myself, so I wouldn't pay a cut for matches. I might use the free promo code tracking with creators I pick myself, but paying 10% on top for Mitra to choose them doesn't feel worth it.
objection: I can just DM creators myself, why pay a middleman? And at a busy counter my staff won't remember to tap +1 every time, so the customer count could be wrong anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another Bengaluru cafe's real numbers, where a creator Mitra matched brought clearly more paying customers per rupee than the ones they found themselves.
